description: This source file defines classes and functions for configuring and interacting with S3/MinIO-compatible object storage, including uploading files and generating signed URLs.

classes.name: StorageConfig
classes.description: Configuration data class for S3/MinIO storage, loaded from environment variables.

classes.name: S3StorageService
classes.description: Class providing methods to upload files, generate presigned URLs, and construct object URLs for S3/MinIO storage.

methods.name: "StorageConfig" from_env()
methods.description: Loads storage configuration from environment variables and returns a StorageConfig instance.

methods.name: None __init__(self, config: StorageConfig)
methods.description: Initializes the S3StorageService with a given StorageConfig, setting up the boto3 client.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str] upload_file(self, local_path: str, storage_key: str, content_type: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Uploads a local file to S3/MinIO storage, returning the bucket and key.

methods.name: Optional[str] generate_presigned_url(self, storage_key: str, method: str = "get_object")
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL for an object key, or returns None if generation fails.

methods.name: Optional[str] object_url(self, storage_key: str)
methods.description: Constructs a non-signed URL using a public base URL if configured.
